name: Ukulingisa okuthuthukile
panel.honest: Izifundo ezingalingani nezokuthintana kulolu cwaningo lokulingisa lwale ngxenye. Yithuluzi lokuhlaziya kunjiniyela, hhayi ukuvunywa kwemklamo: hlola izinombolo ngokubala ngesandla noma ngenye inhlelo.
part.heading: Le ngxenye
part.no_study: Le ngxenye ayinocwaningo lokulingisa okwamanje. Khetha uhlobo locwaningo ngezansi ukuze uqale, bese usetha impahla, izisekelo nemithwalo endaweni yokusebenza yokulingisa.
part.need_bcs: Izisekelo nemithwalo zikhethwa ezinhlangothini endaweni yokusebenza yokulingisa. Lolu thebhu lugcina ezo ucwaningo oluzinazo.
type.heading: Uhlobo locwaningo
type.note: Okungalingani: impahla ilandela ulayini oqondile kuze kufike emkhawulweni wesivuno, bese kuba nokuthambeka okuncane. Ukuthintana: impahla efanayo, kanye nezingcezu zengxenye ezicindezelana. Zombili zigcina izisekelo, imithwalo nempahla yocwaningo.
nl.et_note: Shiya ukuthambeka kungenalutho ukuze kube ngu-1 % we-E ({E} MPa). 0 kusho okuhlehlayo ngokuphelele: ngemva komkhawulo womthwalo izinyathelo azisaxhumi futhi umphumela uyasho lokho.
pairs.heading: Amapheya okuthintana
pairs.one_piece: Ingxenye iyingcezu eyodwa. Ukuthintana kudinga izingcezu ezimbili noma ngaphezulu ezihlukene (isibonelo izikwele ezimbili esikethini esisodwa, eziphushwe).
pairs.none: Ukukhangwa kuze kufike: {gap} mm. Azikho izinhlangothi ezibhekene zezingcezu ezihlukene.
pairs.empty: Awekho amapheya okwamanje. Thola izinhlangothi ezithintayo, noma engeza ipheya endaweni yokusebenza yokulingisa bese ukhetha izinhlangothi zalo khona.
pairs.note: Ukuthintana akunakungqubuzana noma kubotshiwe; imiphumela yendlela yesijeziso ithwala ukungena okushiwo; sebenzisa CalculiX ukuze uthole ukungqubuzana nokunyakaza okukhulu.

plot.label: Igrafu
plot.shown: Amabhendi emibala abekiwe: {n}, eceleni kwengxenye, isimo × {scale}. Ayizinto zokubonisa: azinabo ubunzima, azithunyelwe.
plot.too_big: Igrafu inamatriyangela {n}, ngaphezu kwe-60,000 ethathwa yi-viewport ngokwengeziwe. Sebenzisa igrafu yendawo yokusebenza yokulingisa.
plot.legend: Okuluhlaza {lo} kuya okubomvu {hi} {unit}; isimo sidwetshwe izikhathi {scale} zokunyakaza kwangempela.
plot.note: Ukuze uthole igrafu ephelele namaphrobhu, xazulula lolu cwaningo endaweni yokusebenza yokulingisa: ngucwaningo lwengxenye ngokwayo.
ccx.heading: CalculiX
ccx.never_run: Amafayela e-CalculiX ahlelwe ngokwencwadi ye-CalculiX futhi akakaze aqhutshwe ku-CalculiX. Lindele ukulungisa ifayela lokuqala ngesandla, bese uthumela i-.log yefayela elehlulekayo ku-CadCraft.
ccx.note: I-CalculiX uhlelo oluhlukile olufakwa oluqhutshwa wena; lapha akukho okuyiqhuba. Funda i-.frd kulengxenye ngaphandle kokushintsha ucwaningo, noma imeshi ngeke ihambisane.
ccx.written: Ifayela le-CalculiX lilondoloziwe: amanodi {n}, izakhiwo {e} (akukaze liqhutshwe ku-CalculiX).
ccx.read: Imiphumela ye-CalculiX ifundiwe: amanodi {n}, ukunyakaza okukhulu {d} mm.
ccx.deck_head:
Kubhalwe yi-Advanced simulation add-on ye-PartCraft (CadCraft). Amayunithi: mm, N, MPa, tonne.
AKUHLOLIWE KU-CALCULIX: amafayela avela ku-PartCraft akakaze aqhutshwe ku-CalculiX. Hlola ifayela ngaphambi kokuthembela imiphumela yalo.
why.no_study: Ingxenye ayinocwaningo lokulingisa. Khetha okungalingani noma ukuthintana kuqala.
why.not_nl: Ucwaningo alungo okungalingani noma kokuthintana. Khetha okungalingani noma ukuthintana kuqala.
why.tet_only: Izifundo ezingalingani nezokuthintana zidinga imeshi ye-tetrahedral.
